primaryIssue.description: Enhanced orchestrator shows false project compatibility warnings due to case sensitivity
evidence: Warning: 'Project templum may not be fully supported by build validator'
Case mismatch causes capabilities.supportedProjects.includes(projectInfo.name) to return false
Validation still executes successfully despite warning
primaryIssue.impact: Users see misleading warnings that may cause unnecessary concern, but functionality is not impaired

evidence: Enhanced Validation System v3.0.0 initialized successfully
Validation reports generated in correct markdown format
Proper error handling for non-existent projects

functionalVerification.evidence: System error: Project configuration not found - appropriate error for nonexistent project

issueAnalysis.rootCause: Case sensitivity inconsistency between project configuration naming and validator capability declarations
issueAnalysis.affectedValidators: Likely all validators (build and ui confirmed)
issueAnalysis.systemImpact: Cosmetic only - warnings do not prevent successful validation execution
issueAnalysis.userExperience: Confusing warnings may lead users to think validation is unreliable

recommendedFixes.description: Standardize project naming across configs and validator capabilities
Consider adding '*' wildcard to validator capabilities for universal compatibility
recommendedFixes.rationale: Most validators can work with any project structure
